main_text.l: occurro : defectus hic maximus est virtutis
gratiæ, quod non possit peccaminosum τὸ[?] nolle
consentire, auferre, atque adeo rebellionem ex-
pugnare, præsertim cum victoria nostra, &
de peccato, mundo, & diabolo triumphus
expresse tribuatur divinæ gratiæ robori in scri-
pturis. 1.Pet.1. 5. Phil. c. 4. v. 13. 1.
Ioh. 4. 4. Ephes. 3. 16. Juxta enim Armi-
nianos, si posita sufficienti gratia ejusque acti-
one, manet in me τὸ[?] nolle consentire Deo vo-
canti, procul dubio non vinco Diabolum &
peccatum, ut ait Ioannes, quoniam spiritus
sanctus per gratiam inhabitans in me est forti-
or Diabolo & peccato, quippe posito robore
spiritus gratiosi, fieri potest ut vincat Diabo-
lus qui est in mundo, & non spiritus qui est in
nobis. Si enim non fit ex virtute & robore
gratiæ, quod non fit in me non τὸ[?] nolle con-
sentire Deo vocanti, potius quam in Iuda, tum
erit a pura natura liberi arbitrii, ideoque vi-
ctoria naturæ, non gratiæ debebitur : dent
adversarii tertium, & causa volens excidam.
6. Ut jam gratiæ efficacia & actualis præ-
determinatio magis appareat, notari velim.
Quando nos docemus gratiam prædetermi-
nantem ex vi sua intrinseca inclinare volunta-
tem ad τὸ[?] consentire potius quam ad dissentire,
id tripliciter intelligitur. 1. Quod gratia effi-
cax impediat impetum & motum obliquitatis
& irrectitudinis vitiosæ, quæ libertati extrin-
secè adhæreat, & hunc sensum lubens admit-
to. Nisi enim Deus actualem duritiem in a-
ctibus

page.notes: Greek τὸ before "nolle" and before "consentire" is uncertain: the printed symbol is a small accented tau; read as τὸ, marked [?]. The running head's chapter number is read as "C.ii." and may be "C.ii" with a superscript; marked as read. The initial "occurro" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "Ephes." is printed with a long s in the source, written with a plain s. The underlining of "Quando" in the scan is not transcribed. Last line ends mid-word ("a-" / "ctibus") and continues on the next page.
